incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered alert for synthetic-canary / us-west-1 — 5 failures in last 2m. probe_id=canary-synth-001, failure_type=timeout, sample_error="upstream connection timed out after 10s" :rotating_light:
pd-bot: Incident created: PD-INC-4821. Escalation level 1 paging Jordan (oncall).
Jordan (oncall): acked. jumping in. first look — can everyone drop recent deploys? @Sara @Pranav
Sara (sre): no deploys in last 30m from infra team. pulling canary logs now.
Pranav (runtime): seeing repeated 504s from prober to runtime-gateway-2; KV cache showing stalled connections. could be overload or a routing flap.
Jordan (oncall): ok, set low blast: disable canary fanout to other regions, keep probe single region to limit noise. @Pranav can you toggle?
Pranav (runtime): doing toggle now — command: `./proberctl set-fanout canary-synth-001 --regions us-west-1`
Pranav (runtime): output: `OK — fanout limited to us-west-1 (was global)`. will monitor for 30s.
Sara (sre): quick check: host runtime-gateway-2 CPU spiking ~95%, iowait elevated. kernel logs show many TCP retransmits. suspect network blip on node NIC.
Mike (platform): spotted a noisy infra job on that k8s node — large checkpoint snapshot to S3 started 90s before first failures. throttling storage egress. spinning up replacement node and cordoning the unhealthy one.
Jordan (oncall): good catch. @Mike estimate time to drain/replace?
Mike (platform): replacement pod scheduled, should be ready ~2m. scaling pool by +1 in ephemeral group. cordon+drain in progress.
Pranav (runtime): while node recovers, switching canary to fallback endpoint (runtime-gateway-1) to keep checks green. `./proberctl set-target canary-synth-001 runtime-gateway-1`
Pranav (runtime): prober now hitting gateway-1, initial success on 3/3 attempts.
pd-bot: PD-INC-4821 acknowledged by Jordan. Escalation held.
Jordan (oncall): marking impact: internal synthetic checks failing; external customer reports none yet. scope: single region, partial probe failure. severity: P2 for now.
Alice (customer-success): I have an open chat from a customer in us-west who reported intermittent slow responses to embeddings call ~10:40 PST. I linked PD-INC-4821. keeping them updated.
Sara (sre): metrics improving after draining node. latency tail dropping back to baseline. will continue 15m watch.
Jordan (oncall): leaving a note for handoff: I'll take the next 20m, then hand to next oncall if stable. If failures reappear, escalate to SRE lead and oncall-manager.
pd-bot: PD-INC-4821 -> resolved (auto) after probe stabilization? Not resolving until oncall closes.
Jordan (oncall): closing PD after 25m stable — marking root cause: noisy checkpoint job causing storage egress saturation -> node network IO spike -> runtime gateway overwhelmed -> canary timeouts. Mitigation: limit snapshot concurrency + preferred scheduling on non-egress nodes. Follow-up: postmortem + schedule storage snapshot rate limit.
Sara (sre): noted. I'll open a follow-up ticket and assign to platform/storage cadence.
Mike (platform): ticket created INFRA-2147: add snapshot concurrency guard and node labels to keep heavy egress off runtime nodes. ETA: next sprint.
Alice (customer-success): notified affected customer that we've mitigated and are tracking RCA/Ticket INFRA-2147. they appreciated quick update. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (oncall): thanks team. leaving channel, will hand to next oncall if anything pops.
pd-bot: PD-INC-4821 closed by Jordan.
incident-bot: log summary attached to thread (probe logs, node metrics, commands executed).
Sara (sre): postmortem draft incoming — will include timeline, mitigation steps, and testing plan for snapshot throttling.
Pranav (runtime): for follow-up: add circuit-breaker in prober to avoid simultaneous fanout to multiple gateways when retries spike. filing RUNTIME-99.
Jordan (oncall): end of thread. Thanks everyone.
